Beautiful Ambiance and Superior Service
Feb 2019 • Couples
We "discovered" The Red Curtain while jogging through the alleys of Tay Ho the other day. Just seeing the fireplace and the warmth of the dining area made us completely change our dinner plans that night. We went home and cleaned up so that we could return for a nice date night. The ambiance is one of the best I've found in the area. It's classy, warm and yet has a mixture of local and Western touches. The server was incredibly kind and helpful. 

As the for the food, there were a few things that we'd wished had been done better. The burger, as is so often the case in Hanoi, was a bit smothered by the enormous bun. But, the burger itself was very tasty. I ordered the smoked pork with gravy. The gravy is actually a really nice red wine reduction, I think. However, the smoked pork was just super-thin slices of ham. I was a bit disappointed though the salads were great. That said, the service is great and we're going to return to try other items on the menu. The place is just too cute to not try again.
